name: Hue-style coffee
summary: A thick coffee in thị trấn Cầu Hai, before the market. Thanh Niên, 14 March 2016, calls it Huế-style and thick. No cafe is named. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Thị trấn Cầu Hai, the town at the Bach Ma gate. Thanh Niên tastes it there on the way to the mountain.
texture: Thanh Niên calls the cup thick.
howToEat: Drink it in the morning in the town, then cross the road into chợ Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên does not name a cafe.
An hour is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Thị trấn Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên does not name a door. The market is across the road.
